turnaround_reason: QuidelOrtho merged Quidel's rapid antigen tests with Ortho Clinical Diagnostics' blood typing/transfusion business in 2022, just as COVID test revenues collapsed from their pandemic peak. The combined entity carries significant merger debt and has been posting large losses (EPS -$17.85 TTM) while working to stabilize its core diagnostic portfolio (flu, RSV, blood banking). Stock fell from $35+ to below $10 before the current partial recovery to $17.
bullish_points: Significant revenue base: Q1 FY26 revenue of $619.8M annualizes to ~$2.5B — for a $1.2B market cap company, EV/Revenue is below 1x if debt is manageable
Stock has already doubled off 52w low ($9.92 to $17.52), and +39% YTD/1-year suggests a recovery narrative is taking hold
Earnings catalyst imminent: Q2 report July 29, 2026 (9 days) — any sign of EPS trajectory turning positive or cost-cutting biting could re-rate sharply
52w high of $35.58 suggests consensus once believed in the combined company; if restructuring delivers, there is meaningful upside to retest that level
bearish_points: Zero open-market insider buying in 6 months (all transactions are derivative conversions and stock grants) — no insiders putting personal capital on the line
EPS deeply negative at -$17.85 TTM — company is losing money at scale; turnaround timeline unclear
Jefferies downgraded to Hold on May 7, 2026 — recent institutional skepticism from a credible sell-side house
yfinance fundamental data failed entirely — revenue mix, debt levels, and cash position unknown from dossier alone
Analyst consensus ($18.62) offers only ~6% upside from current; wide analyst range ($11-$38) signals high uncertainty
catalyst: Q2 FY26 earnings report and management guidance update
suggested_trade: Skip — no insider buying, negative EPS, recent institutional downgrade; watch through Q2 earnings on July 29 and reassess if print shows EPS trajectory turning
key_risk: Earnings miss on July 29 with no credible path to profitability resets the turnaround narrative to zero
would_skip_if: Always at current conviction — no open-market insider buying and persistently negative earnings with recent downgrade are disqualifying for entry now
